scoring_justification: Recomputing from raw DFT artifacts is infeasible in the verifier sandbox; result-level comparison against paper gold with tolerances is used.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold values for strain-induced changes in oxygen vacancy formation energy
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper section III.D: 'a ~75 meV increase for 2% compressive strain and 5 meV decrease for 2% tensile strain'

outputs.description: Strain‑induced change in oxygen vacancy formation energy (ΔΩ) for ±2% biaxial strain, extracted from total‑energy differences.

output_contract.notes: Only the relative changes ΔΩ are scored. The checker verifies the reported values against the paper‑reported result with empirical tolerances.

steps.description: Compare the two delta values to paper gold within tolerances.
